file_sharing.hero_pill: File Sharing & Media Storage for Film Teams
file_sharing.hero_sub: Film productions generate enormous amounts of material. Files live in cloud drives, private folders, email threads, and messaging apps. Different versions circulate. Links expire. Teams ask the same question repeatedly: which file is the real one?
file_sharing.problem_title: Productions don't struggle with having files.
file_sharing.problem_title_highlight: They struggle with finding the right one.
file_sharing.problem_desc: Most productions rely on general file storage systems. They are reliable for storing documents. But filmmaking requires something more specific.
file_sharing.problem_card_title: These are the questions no one can answer.
file_sharing.problem_q1: Which file is the real one?
file_sharing.problem_q3: Where did that reference image go?
file_sharing.problem_q4: Did anyone get the updated script?
file_sharing.problem_tools_footer: …and no one is sure which version is current.
file_sharing.problem_bottom: This is not a storage problem. It is a coordination problem.
file_sharing.core_desc: One platform. The complete production media lifecycle. Everything your team needs — from upload to delivery — in one connected workspace.
file_sharing.core_feat1_desc: Files live inside the same environment as scripts and scenes. No context switching, no disconnected folders.
file_sharing.core_feat2_desc: One source of truth. Teams always see the latest version without chasing down which file is current.
file_sharing.core_feat3_desc: Share scripts, references, and assets instantly with permission controls that keep the right people in — and others out.
file_sharing.core_feat4_desc: AI supports visual exploration and asset generation within the project context. Creative direction always stays human.
file_sharing.context_desc: When media lives inside the production system, behaviour begins to shift.
file_sharing.context_card1_desc: A visual reference stays attached to its scene. Design assets remain visible to the departments that need them.
file_sharing.context_card2_desc: Everyone sees the latest version because there is only one source of truth — not five folders and a thread.
file_sharing.context_card3_desc: Teams spend less time hunting for files and more time using them to move production forward.
file_sharing.context_card4_desc: Files stop being static attachments — they become part of the working production environment.
file_sharing.context_bottom_highlight: They become part of the production itself.
file_sharing.context_banner_h1: Pzaz doesn't add another storage layer.
file_sharing.context_banner_h2: It puts files inside the production.
file_sharing.context_banner_desc: Media management should not be a separate app. It should be built into the same environment as your scripts, scenes, schedules, and planning.
file_sharing.craft_desc: When media lives inside the production system, behaviour begins to shift.
file_sharing.craft1_desc: Teams stop wasting hours hunting for assets and start spending that time on the creative and operational work that matters.
file_sharing.craft2_desc: Notes and comments stay attached to the correct version, so context is never lost between reviews.
file_sharing.craft3_desc: Everyone sees the latest version of every asset, eliminating the cycle of chasing updates across tools.
file_sharing.craft_bottom_highlight: They become part of the working production environment.
file_sharing.modern_desc: Wherever your team is, Pzaz keeps the whole production library in sync.
file_sharing.modern_p1: Today's productions generate more media than ever, often across multiple locations and departments. Pzaz keeps production assets organised inside a cloud-based environment where everyone sees the same evolving library of files.
file_sharing.modern_p2: The right assets remain visible at the right moment, and creative teams stay focused on the work rather than the everlasting search.
file_sharing.modern_quote: Your files stay organised. Your project vision stays clear.
file_sharing.ai_pill: Your Entire Production Library in One Place
file_sharing.ai_desc: AI tools can generate images and assets quickly. But without project context, those outputs rarely help a real production move forward.
file_sharing.ai_p1: Inside Pzaz, AI operates within the full project environment. It can support visual exploration and asset generation while remaining connected to the scenes, shots, and creative structure of the production.
file_sharing.ai_p2: It does not replace creative direction or override production decisions. That remains the responsibility of the directors and producers.
file_sharing.ai_quote: AI assists creativity — but the production always remains guided by the people.
file_sharing.usps_desc: Every capability is designed for producers, directors, department heads, and crews who need media to stay connected to the production at all times.
file_sharing.usp1_desc: Store production files securely in the cloud with enterprise-grade protection so your assets are safe throughout the lifecycle.
file_sharing.usp1_highlight: Raw footage, final exports, scripts, and references — all protected and accessible from anywhere.
file_sharing.usp2_desc: Share scripts, references, and assets instantly across departments without email chains or expiring links.
file_sharing.usp2_highlight: The right file reaches the right person at the right moment — no chase required.
file_sharing.usp3_desc: Organise files within structured project folders that mirror the production itself — scenes, departments, and stages.
file_sharing.usp3_highlight: A storyboard image belongs to a scene. A reference belongs to a shot. Context is never lost.
file_sharing.usp4_desc: Control access with clear permission settings so every department sees what it needs — and nothing it shouldn't.
file_sharing.usp4_highlight: Sensitive budget documents stay private. Creative references stay accessible. You decide.
file_sharing.usp5_desc: Maintain version clarity across the production so teams always know which file is current without asking.
file_sharing.usp5_highlight: No more script_v3_FINAL_2_REVISED. One file. One version. Always current.
file_sharing.usp6_desc: AI supports visual exploration and asset generation while remaining connected to the scenes and creative structure of the production.
file_sharing.usp6_highlight: AI assists creativity — but the production always remains guided by the people behind it.
file_sharing.usp7_desc: Keep media libraries searchable and organised so teams spend time using assets, not hunting for them.
file_sharing.usp7_highlight: Search by scene, department, file type, or keyword — find it in seconds.
file_sharing.usp8_desc: Media coordination stays connected to scripts, scenes, and planning — never drifting into isolated storage.
file_sharing.usp8_highlight: When a scene changes, the related assets update. The production stays in sync.
file_sharing.cta_title: Keep Your Production Library in Sync.
file_sharing.cta_desc: When media storage lives inside the same infrastructure as the rest of production, your files stay organised and your project vision stays clear.
file_sharing.cta_body: Centralise your files. Protect your assets. Keep your production in sync.
